title: PolicyDecisionResponse
description: A policy decision. Only a well-formed response with decision APPROVED may allow a journal to proceed to APPROVED; every other outcome, including a malformed response, keeps the journal out of POSTED.

decisionId.description: Policy-service identifier of this decision; the ledger stores it on the journal for audit.

transactionId.description: Echo of the request's transactionId. The ledger rejects a response whose transactionId does not match (treated as contract incompatibility).

policyVersion.description: Identifier of the exact policy version evaluated, e.g. 'default-limits@7'. Opaque to the ledger; recorded for traceability.

reasonCodes.description: Machine-readable reasons. Empty only when decision is APPROVED.
